thread.title: World’s most successful people wake up at 4 a.m. — true, false or just annoying? - MarketWatch

author: Shawn Langlois
title: World’s most successful people wake up at 4 a.m. — true, false or just annoying? - MarketWatch
text:
Are you a failure? Try waking up earlier, slacker. Like, 4 a.m., maybe.
Hey, Apple’s AAPL, -0.69% Tim Cook, Starbucks’s SBUX, -1.32% Howard Schultz and Michelle Obama all apparently do it , so it must work, right?
Wrong, if the reaction to this tweet from Inc. magazine is any indication:
The world's most successful people start their day at 4 a.m. https://t.co/seF0U4XWp8
— Inc. (@Inc) December 17, 2018 Oscar Wilde pretty much sums up the snarky social-media response with this Quote: : “Only dull people are brilliant at breakfast.”
Or, as another famous author put it:
Oh, piss off. https://t.co/DohNNW2Fcp
— J.K. Rowling (@jk_rowling) December 17, 2018 The Inc. tweet linked to a story that actually offered up some reasonable, if rather obvious, advice for squeezing the most productivity out of your day — stuff like follow a routine, avoid jumping right into email, minimize distractions, etc.
But it seems most didn’t make it past the tweet:
If you aspire to be a mid-level executive at a middling department store chain, then wake up at 4 AM. Otherwise, sleep in. pic.twitter.com/Y7PNu6qXyD
— Nate Silver (@NateSilver538) December 17, 2018 1. This is a super narrow definition of success
2. Getting enough sleep is directly related to your mental, emotional, and physical health
3. The work > everything myth is so prevelant it’s wild
4. Don’t accept pressure or narratives without deciding for yourself what matters https://t.co/EJxq7hwSVW
— 『 Robert Vore 』 (@RobertVore) December 17, 2018 Well I have to get up at 4 am three times I week and I'm not successful!!!
— Carolyn Wright (@CarolynWright19) December 17, 2018 The most successful people lie. For example, they tell you that they start their day at 4 am. I don't count peeing due to an enlarged prostate as "starting your day".
— Filosofella (@filosofella) December 17, 2018 I start my work days at 4 am and I’m not successful and I’m tired and clinically depressed https://t.co/iMV4Kx4lKE
— a genderless vegan hotdog with no bun (@the_myleg_fish) December 17, 2018 Are you an early riser? How do you get the most out of your day?
